adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, calendar selection is now `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when not found. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the legacy path for destinations without `destination.credentialId` (the `else` branch inside the `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop) iterates credentials by `type === destination.integration` and calls `createEvent(c, event)` without any way to convey `destination.externalId`. Since those destination entries have `credentialId` undefined by definition of that branch, the `find(cal.credentialId === credentialId)` will never match and Google events will be inserted into the primary calendar (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`), instead of the previously used destination `externalId` (old code used `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar.externalId`). This is a silent behavioral regression for legacy destinationCalendar rows lacking credentialId.
